notes: The lyrics are timed by the model listening to the actual recording now, so it hears the tempo, the beat, the instrumental sections and the returning choruses instead of counting how long each line is.
A short line is no longer handed as much time as a long one. The old layout shared the song out by character count, which is what pushed whole verses off the beat on songs that change speed.
A tap on a lyric line only moves the highlight now. Reading a line no longer jumps the song to that line, so the audio keeps playing exactly where it was.
Tapping a line lights it and brings it into view, and the highlight holds there for a few seconds before playback takes it back, so a press is a reading aid rather than a scrub.
Line up still pins the lines by hand, and a hand-pinned timing is still remembered for the song and never re-timed on top of you.
The widget and the player are unchanged - a press on the home-screen widget still resumes the song without opening the app.
